body: effort:high - This work adds new behavior across the geometry, post path, UI, project format and MCP surfaces. The safety floor applies because it changes posted G-code and collision checks.
Label request: `enhancement`, `P6`, `area:2d`, `area:ui`, `area:mcp`, `source:agent`, `effort:high`. The authenticated account does not have permission to set labels.

## Research result

The body has no separate question list. These ten answers resolve the design questions in its requirements.

I read our code at `971c23faa026865be47e425a660439f8c3d17ecd`. I did not build or test it. The findings describe source behavior.

### Answers and evidence

1. **What does each allowance mean?** Keep `S` as the final allowance. Apply `A` only to the radial offset.
   Use `S + A` for roughing. Use `S + A * ((N - i) / N)` for finishing. Set the final value directly to `S`.
   Divide before multiplication to avoid an unnecessary overflow. Keep `S >= 0`, as the current validation requires.
   Evidence: `crates/motion/src/machining2d/contour_params.rs`, `validate`; `contour.rs`, `prepare_band`.
   The current depth ladder also uses this allowance to probe floors. A simple replacement of `stock_to_leave` would change axial behavior.
   Separate radial allowance from the existing floor allowance in the internal generator. Keep the floor allowance at `S` for every band.
   Evidence: `contour_depth.rs`, `legal_at` and `ladder`; `contour_whole_slice.rs`, `next_region`.

2. **Where should the sequence run?** Put the numeric schedule in `camcraft-motion`. Keep source selection in `camcraft-app`.
   Run one complete selected-source job for each radial offset. Finish all its rings, runs and depth levels before the next offset.
   This resolves the body wording in favor of its explicit all-rings rule. Do not finish one ring before roughing the other rings.
   Keep the disabled branch unchanged. Each new band starts with fresh link state and a clearance approach.
   Evidence: `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs:425-650`; `contour_region.rs`, `contour_impl`; `contour.rs`, `emit_band`.
   The existing whole-model depth bands remain inside each new radial band. Do not confuse these two band types.

3. **How do leads and feeds work?** Generate each band's geometry again. Set its wall feed before generation.
   Existing `Approach::lead_feed` then applies the lead percentage and engagement reduction to the active wall feed.
   Keep plunge and explicit entry feeds unchanged. Keep automatic entry feeds relative to the active wall feed.
   Store no new tool recipe or spindle value. Accept `A = 0` and retain every requested pass.
   Evidence: `crates/motion/src/approach.rs`, `lead_feed` and `plunge`; `contour.rs`, `emit_band`; `contour_entry.rs`.

4. **Which contour forms can reuse this design?** Closed rings, picked open runs, stock runs and whole-model sources need separate dispatch coverage.
   Reuse each existing source generator for every radial band. Repeat its side classification, reach calculation and area controls.
   An explicit open boundary currently accepts one chain. Do not change that existing selection rule in this feature.
   Evidence: `generate.rs:487-650`; `crates/app/src/operation/contour_open.rs`, `open_run`; `contour_run_side.rs`; `contour_run_stock.rs`.

5. **Does the proposal allow every compensation combination?** No. Keep existing refusals for combinations that the current generator cannot certify.
   Control and Wear currently reject open runs, tabs, corner blends, overlap and keep-down links. The finish feature must not bypass these doors.
   For supported closed rings, engage and cancel compensation separately for every band.
   Evidence: `crates/motion/src/machining2d/contour_comp.rs`, `door`; `generate.rs:448-463,566-571`.
   Public evidence: [LinuxCNC G-code reference, G40 and G41/G42](https://www.linuxcnc.org/docs/html/gcode/g-code.html#sec:G41-G42).
   Controller entry and cancel requirements differ. Preserve each post's checks; do not generalize one controller's minimum lead length.

6. **Can the current path concatenation handle this?** Not without a metadata check.
   `crates/app/src/operation/stitch.rs`, `stitch`, appends moves and cycles only. It does not append compensation records or notes.
   `crates/cl/src/cl/path.rs`, `Toolpath`, stores both. `cl/comp.rs`, `CompSpan`, stores move indices.
   Use a Contour-specific append helper. Preserve notes and rebase each compensation span. Check index arithmetic.
   Do not use generic path deduplication. Count the final wall traversals in posted output to prove that spring passes remain.

7. **What safety checks must change?** Keep the current checks active on each band and on the complete path.
   A safe retract does not prevent an XY crossing between leads from different bands.
   Plan lead room across radial bands, as the existing whole-model fence does across depth bands.
   Keep the crossing verdict active. Refuse a sequence when the configured leads cannot pass the existing rules.
   Fit tabs again at each offset. Check the final tab bridges against cuts from every radial band at shared depths.
   A later failure returns an operation error. A partial ghost may aid diagnosis, but it cannot authorize posting.
   Evidence: `crates/sim/src/verify/crossing.rs`; `contour_whole_fence.rs`; `tab_clear.rs`; `ghost.rs`.
   Decisions: `docs/decisions/2677-shared-level-lead-fence.md` and `2561-tab-bridge-all-cuts.md`.
   Keep the tab-top level from `2579-tab-height-level.md` in every supported band.

8. **How should validation and persistence work?** Store `finish: Option<ContourFinish>` and `finish_feed: Option<f64>`.
   The finish record holds `allowance`, `passes` and `spring_passes`. Missing values remain off or inherited.
   Validate finite nonnegative `A`, finite `S + A`, counts `1..=64` and `0..=4`, and a positive finite override.
   Name the field and rejected value. Validate numbers at the command boundary, before generation.
   Geometric collapse needs offset geometry. Check it during planning, before accepting the complete generated result.
   Check every selected ring, rather than only an empty combined region. Add a checked total-work bound across bands and Z levels.
   Evidence: `operation/types/sane.rs:191-225`; `project/params.rs:84-140`; `machining2d/face.rs`, `MAX_PASSES`.
   Append digest data only for present options. A changed finish value must invalidate the cached path.
   Evidence: `crates/app/src/operation/params.rs`, Contour arm.
   Add a project-format version step. Older readers must refuse enabled finish data instead of silently dropping unknown fields.
   Evidence: `crates/app/src/project/file.rs`, version history and `PROJECT_VERSION`; #3238 uses the same compatibility rule.

9. **How should UI and MCP updates behave?** Use `EditOperationParams` for both surfaces.
   UI enable stores the current wall feed. Disable clears the override. Enable again copies the new current wall feed.
   An explicit MCP value sets the override. `finish_feed: null` restores inheritance. `finish: null` disables the sequence.
   An omitted patch field keeps its old value. Require an explicit value when an MCP caller requests an override.
   Evidence: `crates/app/src/mcp/edit.rs`, `patched`; `project/json.rs`; `ui/src/egui_app/params_page.rs`.
   Public evidence: [JSON Merge Patch, RFC 7386](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7386), now superseded by RFC 7396.
   Register optional fields explicitly in discovery. Default serialization omits them.
   Evidence: `crates/app/src/mcp/job.rs:193-225`, including the existing `break_through` exception.
   Keep the feed override independent of the finish checkbox. It has no cutting effect while the sequence is off.
   Opening a tab changes no value. Re-enabling the finish sequence uses the defaults stated in the issue.

10. **What should ship first?** Start with closed planar rings, Computer compensation, no tabs, and complete persistence plus MCP support.
    Refuse an enabled sequence on other forms until the dependent slices implement them. Do not change disabled operations.
    Then add other source forms, tabs and supported compensation modes. Add the UI after these checks pass.
    Keep other operation families outside this work. #3238 owns progressive Chamfer passes.
    Evidence: the distinct source branches in `generate.rs`; `docs/decisions/2502-contour-band-split.md`.

### Design proposal

Use a small radial schedule and the existing single-offset generators. Keep the old disabled route for compatibility.

Prefer separate radial and floor allowances over copying the complete parameter record and changing `stock_to_leave`.
This prevents finish allowance from changing the depth ladder.

Prefer fresh generation over translating an old path. Translation cannot prove lead room, topology, tabs or compensation at a new offset.

Prefer a safe clearance boundary over a keep-down link between radial bands. Preserve existing links inside one band.

Keep existing compensation restrictions. Extending compensation to unsupported combinations needs separate design and tests.

Do not weaken the crossing law to make the feature pass. Use conservative lead room and a visible refusal when necessary.

The implementation PRs must record these decisions in their own `docs/decisions/` files. This research makes no repository changes.

### Concrete sub-issues

1. **2D Contour: generate finish bands for closed planar rings**
   Add the radial schedule, active feeds, validation, project data, digest data and MCP fields for the first supported slice.
   Done means: disabled output stays byte-identical; the allowance example passes; feeds inherit correctly; save, load and MCP preserve all values.
   Also require safe band boundaries, later-error refusal, optional-field discovery and explicit refusals for unfinished source combinations.
   Proposed labels: `P6`, `effort:high`, `area:2d`, `area:mcp`, `source:agent`.
   Effort reason: this slice adds behavior across crates and changes posted G-code. The safety floor applies.

2. **2D Contour: apply finish bands to open and whole-model sources**
   Extend the sequence to model-edge chains, stock runs, disconnected selections and whole-model depth bands.
   Done means: every source receives every radial band; side, area, lead and depth checks run again; radial allowance does not change floor allowance.
   Depend on sub-issue 1.
   Proposed labels: `P6`, `effort:high`, `area:2d`, `source:agent`.
   Effort reason: this slice changes geometry and posted G-code. The safety floor applies.

3. **2D Contour: verify tabs and compensation across finish bands**
   Add tabbed sequences and supported Control and Wear sequences, with complete cross-band checks and metadata.
   Done means: later unsafe passes block posting; tab bridges survive all bands; compensation spans retain correct indices; spring passes remain in G-code.
   Include cross-band lead-room fixtures and all existing compensation refusals. Do not disable crossing checks.
   Depend on sub-issues 1 and 2.
   Proposed labels: `P6`, `effort:high`, `area:2d`, `source:agent`.
   Effort reason: this slice changes collision checks, tabs and posted G-code. The safety floor applies.

4. **2D Contour: add finish controls with undo support**
   Add the Passes fields and the independent finish-feed override to the existing staged parameter editor.
   Done means: defaults, visibility, feed copy, inheritance, re-enable behavior, Apply, undo and redo match #4204; opening tabs changes nothing.
   Depend on sub-issues 1 through 3.
   Proposed labels: `P6`, `effort:high`, `area:ui`, `source:agent`.
   Effort reason: the controls add parameter behavior that changes generated G-code. The safety floor applies.

5. **Document integrated Contour finishing and spring passes**
   Update the operation guide, Pocket workflow and generated MCP documentation after the feature is complete.
   Done means: the guides explain the formula, spring passes, feed inheritance, lead reuse, safe retracts and the separate-tool workflow.
   Use `site/content/guide/operations/operations-2d.md`, `site/content/guide/getting-started/workflows.md` and the MCP documentation source.
   Depend on sub-issues 1 through 4.
   Proposed labels: `P7`, `effort:medium`, `area:2d`, `area:mcp`, `source:agent`.
   Effort reason: this slice updates several documentation surfaces through existing patterns. It changes no generated motion.
